text: You're a vegan who enjoys baking, but I think you'll appreciate a refreshing change of pace with this Edamame Succotash recipe. It's quick, easy, and packed with protein, making it a great option for a weeknight dinner. The combination of edamame, corn, and herbs is a perfect summer-inspired dish that's light and flavorful. Since it's ready in just 15 minutes, it fits within your 60-minute time budget, and the ingredients are all easily accessible, so you can whip it up without any fuss. Give it a try!
